title: 🧑‍💼 Members (Cat Interns)
intro: We have formed a small team of “Cat Interns” — two cats dedicated to ensuring humanity and ceremony in our lab. Their main output includes purring, workstation logistics, and morale maintenance.

members.name: Huang Dou
members.focus: Regular robustness inspections of keyboards, desks, and laptop lids; ensuring the stability of the workspace.
responsibilities: Responsible for robustness testing of the workstation structure.
Responsible for stability maintenance of workstation equipment.
Responsible for maintaining the mental well-being of team members.

members.name: Xiao Ju
members.focus: Maintaining and supervising the office atmosphere.
responsibilities: Supervising ergonomic keyboard usage by occupying key areas.
Providing purring feedback loops during working hours.
Night-time patrols to reduce safety incidents.
